code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate a full straight divider of color 2.
    if all(all(v==2 for v in row) for row in g):
        axis='h'; d=next(i for i,row in enumerate(g) if row[0]==2)
    elif all(all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)):
        axis='v'; d=next(j for j in range(w) if g[0][j]==2)
    else:
        return g
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (2,9)]
    if not pts: return g
    if axis=='v':
        lo=min(j for i,j in pts); hi=max(j for i,j in pts)
        if hi<d: shift=(d-1)-hi
        else: shift=(d+1)-lo
        moved=[(i,j+shift,g[i][j]) for i,j in pts]
        for i,j,_ in pts: g[i][j]=9
        for i,j,v in moved: g[i][j]=v
        edge=min(j for i,j,v in moved)-1 if max(j for i,j,v in moved)<d else max(j for i,j,v in moved)+1
        if 0<=edge<w:
            for i in range(h): g[i][edge]=8
    else:
        lo=min(i for i,j in pts); hi=max(i for i,j in pts)
        if hi<d: shift=(d-1)-hi
        else: shift=(d+1)-lo
        moved=[(i+shift,j,g[i][j]) for i,j in pts]
        for i,j in pts: g[i][j]=9
        for i,j,v in moved: g[i][j]=v
        edge=min(i for i,j,v in moved)-1 if max(i for i,j,v in moved)<d else max(i for i,j,v in moved)+1
        if 0<=edge<h:
            g[edge]=[8]*w
    return g
'''
